events.title: Citi Sky AI Assistant Highlights Citigroup Wealth Push With Google Partnership
events.body: Citi Wealth, part of Citigroup (NYSE:C), has launched Citi Sky, an AI powered digital assistant for wealth management clients. The tool is built in partnership with Google Cloud and Google DeepMind, using generative AI and real time avatar

events.title: Sector Update: Financial Stocks Rise Late Afternoon
events.body: Financial stocks advanced in late Tuesday afternoon trading with the NYSE Financial Index rising 0.6
